checks.name: corrected_metric_entries
checks.detail: for every real z (sin z, cos z signed, (sin^2 z)^(1/6) > 0): g00 = e^(-2 a4) b4 cot^2 z >= 0, g_ii = e^(2 a4) > 0, g44 = -1, g_tt = -e^(-2 a4) b4 (sin^2 z)^(1/6) < 0 (signature (4,4) wherever sin z cos z != 0); the diagonal vielbein f0 = e^(-a4) b4^(1/2) cot z (signed), f_i = e^(a4), f4 = 1, f_t = e^(-a4) b4^(1/2) (sin^2 z)^(1/12) reproduces it, and f0 f1...f7 = e^(-a4) b4^2 cot z (sin^2 z)^(1/4) (sqrt|g| = its absolute value)

checks.name: record_metric_offdiagonal_reproduced
checks.detail: metric of 2026-10-14 (every real z): E_(k) has exactly the off-diagonal pair (x4, x0), (x0, x4) for k = 1, 2, 3, and sum_k alpha_k E_(k)^x4_x0 equals the record's generalSource.offDiagonal_x4x0 (cot z u Q); E_(1)^x4_x0 = (3/2) H cot z b4'/b4

checks.name: version_1_g44_oscillates
checks.detail: version 1 of this record (2026-10-16, withdrawn): g44 = -(sin^2 z)^(1/6) is periodic in z with period Pi, varies with x0 and vanishes at z = n Pi; with z real (-Infinity < z < Infinity) the time lapse oscillates, which the user excluded ("g44 cannot oscillate"); the remedy must keep g44 independent of x0

checks.name: family_g44_fixed_conditions
checks.detail: family with g44 = -1: g00 = b4^(2p) e^(2 q a4) cot^2 z, g_ii = e^(2 a4) (sin^2 z)^(3 alpha), g_tt = -e^(-2 a4) b4 (sin^2 z)^(3 beta): the only mixed Riemann components are R^{x0 xi}_{xi x4}-type ones proportional to alpha ((q - 1) a4' + p b4'/b4) and R^{x0 xt}_{x4 xt}-type ones proportional to beta ((q + 1) a4' + (p - 1/2) b4'/b4); they vanish for all a4, b4 iff [alpha = 0 or (q, p) = (1, 0)] and [beta = 0 or (q, p) = (-1, 1/2)]. The author's two warps (alpha = beta = 1/6) cannot both be kept; keeping the warp of the extra times gives q = -1, p = 1/2, alpha = 0 (the corrected metric), keeping the warp of 3-space gives q = 1, p = 0, beta = 0 (the alternative K)

checks.name: family_einstein_condition
checks.detail: in the same family E_(1)^x4_x0 is proportional to alpha ((q - 1) a4' + p b4'/b4) + beta ((q + 1) a4' + (p - 1/2) b4'/b4): with both warps (alpha = beta = 1/6) it vanishes for all a4, b4 iff q = 0, p = 1/4, i.e. the one-entry change g00 = b4^(1/2) cot^2 z, which satisfies the Einstein equations only (next check)

checks.name: corrected_mixed_riemann_vanish
checks.detail: corrected metric, every real z: R^{ab}_{cd} = 0 whenever {a, b} != {c, d} (28 nonzero components, all of the form R^{ab}_{ab})

checks.name: corrected_offdiagonal_all_orders
checks.detail: corrected metric: all 56 off-diagonal components of E_(1) (Einstein), E_(2) (Gauss-Bonnet) and E_(3) (cubic Lovelock) vanish identically for all a4(x4), b4(x4) > 0, H and every real z, and every diagonal component is independent of x0: the field equations are ordinary differential equations in x4 for a diagonal source that depends on x4 only

checks.name: hidden_block_constant_curvature
checks.detail: the 4-dimensional block cot^2 z dx0^2 - (sin^2 z)^(1/6) (dx5^2 + dx6^2 + dx7^2) of signature (1,3) has constant curvature: R^{ab}_{ab} = -H^2 for all six pairs, no other component (with y = Log|sin z|/(6 H): dy^2 - e^(2 H y) (dx5^2 + dx6^2 + dx7^2) wherever sin z != 0); the corrected metric is -dx4^2 + e^(2 a4) (dx1^2 + dx2^2 + dx3^2) + e^(-2 a4) b4 times this block, so x0 shrinks with the deflating extra times

checks.name: ricci_tensor
checks.detail: corrected metric: the Ricci tensor R^mu_nu = sum_b R^{mu b}_{nu b} is diagonal and independent of x0; R = -(12*EA**2*H**2*bb - 8*ad1**2*bb**2 + 8*ad1*bb*bd1 + 2*ad2*bb**2 - 4*bb*bd2 - bd1**2)/bb**2; recorded in Wolfram form for the field-theory record

checks.name: divergence_of_diagonal_tensor
checks.detail: corrected metric, T = diag(p0, p3, p3, p3, -rho, p_t, p_t, p_t) with entries depending on x0 and x4: nabla_mu T^mu_x4 = -d4 rho - 3 a4' (rho + p3) - 3 h (rho + p_t) - h (rho + p0) with h = b4'/(2 b4) - a4' the rate of the block x0, x5, x6, x7 (each expanding direction dilutes rho + its pressure), nabla_mu T^mu_x0 = d0 p0 + 3 H cot z (p0 - p_t) (the hidden direction balances against the extra times only), the six other components vanish identically; for x0-independent entries the x0 balance needs p0 = p_t. Control: the x4 identity of the metric of 2026-10-14 differs

checks.name: history_source_conserved
checks.detail: on the history a4 = A H x4, b4 = e^(beta A H x4) the source kappa T - Lambda delta = sum_k alpha_k E_(k) (Einstein and the author's weights) is diagonal, independent of x0, with p0 = p_t (the hidden direction and the extra times form one block), and depends on x4 through the curvature term H^2 e^(2 a4)/b4 = H^2 e^((2 - beta) A H x4) of the shrinking block; it satisfies nabla_mu T^mu_nu = 0 (the x4 identity above; the x0 identity holds because p0 = p_t). At A = 1, beta = 4/3 (Einstein): {-rho: H**2*(18*exp(2*H*x4/3) + 1)/3, p0: H**2*(9*exp(2*H*x4/3) - 11)/3, p3: H**2*(54*exp(2*H*x4/3) - 13)/9, p_t: H**2*(9*exp(2*H*x4/3) - 11)/3}

checks.name: dirac_gravity_term
checks.detail: corrected metric, vielbein f0 = e^(-a4) b4^(1/2) cot z, f_i = e^(a4), f4 = 1, f_t = e^(-a4) b4^(1/2) (sin^2 z)^(1/12): gamma^mu Omega_mu = (3/2) H e^(a4) b4^(-1/2) gamma^(x0) + (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4), independent of x0 for every real z (the metric of 2026-10-14: 3 H gamma^(x0) + (3/4)(b4'/b4) gamma^(x4)); on the history (b4'/b4 = (4/3) a4') the gamma^(x4) coefficient is (5/6) a4'

checks.name: milne_flat_check
checks.detail: a4 = 0, b4 = H^2 x4^2 makes every Riemann component of the corrected metric vanish (8-dimensional flat space in Milne form: the block x0, x5, x6, x7 of constant curvature -H^2 scaled by H x4), so all Lovelock tensors vanish: a consistency check of the formulas with b4 not constant, not a physical history (3-space does not expand)

checks.name: alternatives
checks.detail: alternative K = diag(e^(2 a4) cot^2 z, e^(2 a4) (sin^2 z)^(1/6) (x3), -1, -e^(-2 a4) b4 (x3)): no off-diagonal component at any order and diagonal free of x0, but the hidden direction grows with 3-space (the block x0, x1, x2, x3 carries the factor e^(2 a4)), while in the corrected metric it shrinks with the extra times; the Einstein-only change g00 = b4^(1/2) cot^2 z keeps both warps and makes the Einstein tensor diagonal, but E_(2)^x4_x0 = -3*H*bd1*cv*(4*ad1*bb - bd1)**2/(2*bb**3*sv) != 0
